namespace GroupAlgebraInductionAux

open CategoryTheory

universe r s l

section Rings

variable {R : Type r} [Ring R] {S : Type s} [Ring S]

private abbrev Balanced (i : R →+* S) (V : ModuleCat.{l} R)
    (A : Type l) [AddCommGroup A] (p : S → V → A) : Prop :=
  (∀ x y z, p (x + y) z = p x z + p y z) ∧
  (∀ x z z', p x (z + z') = p x z + p x z') ∧
  (∀ (a : R) (x : S) (z : V), p (x * i a) z = p x (a • z))

-- The single-object functor encodes right multiplication by i(a).
-- Associativity gives S-linearity and reverses the order of the endomorphisms.
private def regularBimodule (i : R →+* S) :
    AdditiveFunctor (SingleObj (MulOpposite R)) (ModuleCat.{s} S) := by
  let F : SingleObj (MulOpposite R) ⥤ ModuleCat.{s} S :=
    { obj := fun _ => ModuleCat.of S S
      map := fun a => ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulRight S (i (MulOpposite.unop a)))
      map_id := by
        intro X
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        change x * i 1 = x
        rw [map_one, mul_one]
      map_comp := by
        intro X Y Z a b
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        change x * i (MulOpposite.unop ((show MulOpposite R from b) * (show MulOpposite R from a))) =
          (x * i (MulOpposite.unop a)) * i (MulOpposite.unop b)
        rw [MulOpposite.unop_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc] }
  refine ⟨F, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  intro X Y a b
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change x * i (MulOpposite.unop (a + b)) =
    x * i (MulOpposite.unop a) + x * i (MulOpposite.unop b)
  rw [MulOpposite.unop_add, map_add, mul_add]

-- Use the registered tensor functor and its universal property with this
-- fixed bimodule. The tensor supplier permits arbitrary noncommutative rings
-- and an output universe enlarged to the common module-carrier universe.
-- NotesProofs/BimoduleTensorFunctoriality.lean, checked source SHA-256
-- 02b714b60c6b88656a0155503911d08df6285283088a22566e92b3331e3dd39f.
private theorem tensorForRingMap (i : R →+* S) :
    ∃ (L : ModuleCat.{max s l} R ⥤ ModuleCat.{max s l} S)
      (p : ∀ V : ModuleCat.{max s l} R, S → V → L.obj V),
      (∀ V, Balanced i V (L.obj V) (p V)) ∧
      (∀ (V : ModuleCat.{max s l} R) (A : Type (max s l)) [AddCommGroup A]
        (q : S → V → A), Balanced i V A q →
          ∃! f : L.obj V →+ A, ∀ x z, f (p V x z) = q x z) ∧
      (∀ (V : ModuleCat.{max s l} R) (a x : S) (z : V), a • p V x z = p V (a * x) z) ∧
      (∀ {V V' : ModuleCat.{max s l} R} (f : V ⟶ V') (x : S) (z : V),
        (L.map f).hom (p V x z) = p V' x (f.hom z)) := by
  let B := regularBimodule i
  obtain ⟨F, pure, hObj, hMap, _, _⟩ :=
    BimoduleTensorFunctoriality.{r, s, s, max s l, 0} R S
  refine ⟨Prod.sectR B _ ⋙ F, pure B, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro V
    exact (hObj B V).1
  · intro V A _ q hq
    exact (hObj B V).2.1 (AddCommGrpCat.of A) q hq
  · intro V a x z
    exact (hObj B V).2.2 a x z
  · intro V V' f x z
    exact hMap (𝟙 B) f x z

variable (i : R →+* S) {L : ModuleCat.{l} R ⥤ ModuleCat.{l} S}
  {p : ∀ V : ModuleCat.{l} R, S → V → L.obj V}
  (hp : ∀ V, Balanced i V (L.obj V) (p V))
  (liftUnique : ∀ (V : ModuleCat.{l} R) (A : Type l) [AddCommGroup A]
    (q : S → V → A), Balanced i V A q →
      ∃! f : L.obj V →+ A, ∀ x z, f (p V x z) = q x z)
  (hpSmul : ∀ (V : ModuleCat.{l} R) (a x : S) (z : V), a • p V x z = p V (a * x) z)

include hp liftUnique in
private theorem addHom_ext {V : ModuleCat.{l} R} {A : Type l} [AddCommGroup A]
    (f g : L.obj V →+ A) (h : ∀ x z, f (p V x z) = g (p V x z)) : f = g := by
  have hq : Balanced i V A (fun x z => g (p V x z)) :=
    ⟨fun x y z => by dsimp only; rw [(hp V).1, map_add],
      fun x z z' => by dsimp only; rw [(hp V).2.1, map_add],
      fun a x z => congrArg g ((hp V).2.2 a x z)⟩
  obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := liftUnique V A _ hq
  exact (hk f h).trans (hk g (fun _ _ => rfl)).symm

-- Proposition 7.6 and Alphabeta Math step 1.1. Use the two formulas over
-- the article’s coefficient field. Since restriction acts by i(a), the
-- R-linearity of f and associativity give balance for every a in R.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-induction-is-left-adjoint-and-coinduction-right-adjoint-to-restriction
include hp liftUnique hpSmul in
private theorem extension_exists {V : ModuleCat.{l} R} {W : ModuleCat.{l} S}
    (f : V ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars i).obj W) :
    ∃ g : L.obj V ⟶ W, ∀ x z, g.hom (p V x z) = x • (show W from f.hom z) := by
  let q := fun (x : S) (z : V) => x • (show W from f.hom z)
  have hq : Balanced i V W q := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x y z
      exact add_smul x y _
    · intro x z z'
      dsimp [q]
      rw [f.hom.map_add]
      exact smul_add x (show W from f.hom z) (show W from f.hom z')
    · intro a x z
      dsimp [q]
      rw [f.hom.map_smul]
      exact mul_smul x (i a) _
  obtain ⟨g, hg, _⟩ := liftUnique V W q hq
  refine ⟨ModuleCat.ofHom { __ := g, map_smul' := ?_ }, hg⟩
  intro a z
  let lhs := g.comp (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom (L.obj V) a)
  let rhs := (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom W a).comp g
  have h : lhs = rhs := addHom_ext i hp liftUnique lhs rhs (by
    intro x y
    change g (a • p V x y) = a • g (p V x y)
    rw [hpSmul, hg, hg]
    exact mul_smul a x _)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

private noncomputable def evaluateAtOne {V : ModuleCat.{l} R} {W : ModuleCat.{l} S}
    (g : L.obj V ⟶ W) : V ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars i).obj W := by
  let f : V →ₗ[R] ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars i).obj W : Type l) :=
    { toFun := fun z => g.hom (p V 1 z)
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        exact (congrArg g.hom ((hp V).2.1 1 x y)).trans (g.hom.map_add _ _)
      map_smul' := by
        intro a z
        change g.hom (p V 1 (a • z)) = i a • g.hom (p V 1 z)
        rw [← (hp V).2.2, one_mul, ← g.hom.map_smul, hpSmul, mul_one] }
  exact ModuleCat.ofHom (R := R) (X := V) (Y := ↑((ModuleCat.restrictScalars i).obj W)) f

-- The article needs the induction half of the portal result. We package the
-- two formulas of step 1.1 with naturality on both variables using the
-- balanced tensor from Proposition 6.3. A direct adjunction here keeps the
-- chosen pure-tensor operations. Rep.indResAdjunction uses coinvariants.
-- ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj requires commutative rings, whereas
-- subgroup group algebras can be noncommutative.
include hp liftUnique hpSmul in
private theorem tensorRestrictAdjunction
    (hpMap : ∀ {V V' : ModuleCat.{l} R} (f : V ⟶ V') (x : S) (z : V),
      (L.map f).hom (p V x z) = p V' x (f.hom z)) :
    Nonempty (L ⊣ ModuleCat.restrictScalars i) := by
  classical
  let extend {V : ModuleCat.{l} R} {W : ModuleCat.{l} S}
      (f : V ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars i).obj W) : L.obj V ⟶ W :=
    Classical.choose (extension_exists i hp liftUnique hpSmul f)
  have extend_pure {V : ModuleCat.{l} R} {W : ModuleCat.{l} S}
      (f : V ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars i).obj W) (x : S) (z : V) :
      (extend f).hom (p V x z) = x • (show W from f.hom z) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (extension_exists i hp liftUnique hpSmul f) x z
  let e (V : ModuleCat.{l} R) (W : ModuleCat.{l} S) :
      (L.obj V ⟶ W) ≃ (V ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars i).obj W) :=
    { toFun := evaluateAtOne i hp hpSmul
      invFun := extend
      left_inv := by
        intro g
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_injective
        apply addHom_ext i hp liftUnique
        intro x z
        change (extend (evaluateAtOne i hp hpSmul g)).hom (p V x z) = g.hom (p V x z)
        rw [extend_pure]
        change x • g.hom (p V 1 z) = g.hom (p V x z)
        rw [← g.hom.map_smul, hpSmul, mul_one]
      right_inv := by
        intro f
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro z
        change (extend f).hom (p V 1 z) = (show W from f.hom z)
        rw [extend_pure, one_smul] }
  refine ⟨Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro V V' W f g
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_injective
    apply addHom_ext i hp liftUnique
    intro x z
    change (extend (f ≫ g)).hom (p V x z) =
      (extend g).hom ((L.map f).hom (p V x z))
    rw [hpMap, extend_pure, extend_pure]
    rfl
  · intro V W W' g f
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    rfl

end Rings

end GroupAlgebraInductionAux

external.usage: Compute the image of a coefficient-one group basis element and of a scalar supported at the identity.
Compute the coefficient at the image of a subgroup element using injectivity of Subgroup.subtype.
A group element outside the subgroup lies outside the range of Subgroup.subtype. Its coefficient in the image is zero.
Use the canonical functor. Its scalar action is restriction along the algebra map and its group action is by the coefficient-one basis elements, as used by definitional reduction.
Package evaluation at one and balanced extension as an adjunction after checking the inverse laws and naturality in both variables.

BalancedTensorAssociativity.proof:
by
  intro T S R _ _ _ TS SR starS starR carrierC carrierB rightC rightB
    CB BM CBType BMType Left Right
  -- Evaluate both additive functors at their unique object. Their functor
  -- and additivity laws supply the right-module laws, and their maps are
  -- linear for the original left actions. The quotient identifications
  -- below are definitional, including the classes of the generators.
  let leftCB (C : TS) (B : SR) : Module T (CBType C B) := by
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction C
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm C
    let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite S) T (carrierC C)
    exact NotesBalancedAssoc.leftModule (K := T) (R := S)
      (X := carrierC C) (Y := carrierB B)
  let rightCB (C : TS) (B : SR) : Module (MulOpposite R) (CBType C B) := by
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction C
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B
    exact NotesBalancedAssoc.rightModule (K := MulOpposite R) (R := S)
      (X := carrierC C) (Y := carrierB B)
  let leftBM (B : SR) (M : ModuleCat R) : Module S (BMType B M) := by
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B
    let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite R) S (carrierB B)
    exact NotesBalancedAssoc.leftModule (K := S) (R := R) (X := carrierB B) (Y := M)
  refine ⟨leftCB, rightCB, leftBM, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro C B
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction C
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm C
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B
    let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite S) T (carrierC C)
    exact ⟨NotesBalancedAssoc.commute (R := S) (K := T) (J := MulOpposite R)
        (X := carrierC C) (Y := carrierB B),
      fun t c b => NotesBalancedAssoc.left_pure (R := S) t c b,
      fun r c b => NotesBalancedAssoc.right_pure (R := S) (MulOpposite.op r) c b⟩
  · intro B M s b m
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B
    let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B
    let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite R) S (carrierB B)
    exact NotesBalancedAssoc.left_pure (R := R) s b m
  · intro L U pureL pureU
    let actL (C : TS) (B : SR) (M : ModuleCat R) : Module T (L C B M) := by
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite S) T (carrierC C)
      exact NotesBalancedAssoc.actL (T := T) (S := S) (R := R)
        (X := carrierC C) (Y := carrierB B) (Z := M)
    let actU (C : TS) (B : SR) (M : ModuleCat R) : Module T (U C B M) := by
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite S) T (carrierC C)
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite R) S (carrierB B)
      exact NotesBalancedAssoc.actU (T := T) (S := S) (R := R)
        (X := carrierC C) (Y := carrierB B) (Z := M)
    let α (C : TS) (B : SR) (M : ModuleCat R) :
        letI := actL C B M
        letI := actU C B M
        LinearEquiv (RingHom.id T) (L C B M) (U C B M) := by
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite S) T (carrierC C)
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite R) S (carrierB B)
      exact NotesBalancedAssoc.assoc (T := T) (S := S) (R := R)
        (X := carrierC C) (Y := carrierB B) (Z := M)
    refine ⟨actL, actU, α, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro C B M c b m
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite S) T (carrierC C)
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite R) S (carrierB B)
      exact ⟨NotesBalancedAssoc.assoc_pure (T := T) (S := S) (R := R) c b m,
        fun t => ⟨NotesBalancedAssoc.actL_pure (S := S) (R := R) t c b m,
          NotesBalancedAssoc.actU_pure (S := S) (R := R) t c b m⟩⟩
    · intro C C' B B' M M' f g h
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction C'
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction B'
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm C
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm C'
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B
      let _ := NotesBalancedAssoc.rightAction_comm B'
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite S) T (carrierC C)
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite S) T (carrierC C')
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite R) S (carrierB B)
      let _ := SMulCommClass.symm (MulOpposite R) S (carrierB B')
      exact NotesBalancedAssoc.natural (NotesBalancedAssoc.evalRight f)
        (g.hom.app starR).hom h.hom (fun t c => map_smul (f.hom.app starS).hom t c)
        (fun r b => map_smul (NotesBalancedAssoc.evalRight g) r b)

namespace NotesBalancedAssoc

open CategoryTheory

noncomputable section

-- Ian X, Theorem 6.5, p. 19, and Alphabeta Math's numbered proof:
-- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/abelian-categories-and-bimodules-lecture-notes.pdf#page=19
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-associativity-of-balanced-tensor-products
-- Proofs.BalancedTensorAssociativity was checked with the permitted axioms
-- (source SHA-256 2069082f489690ee0a881df7f2f5ebad33d114cdd97398518f7d740ef23f279e).
-- Its theorem and this endpoint share the global name BalancedTensorAssociativity.
-- Importing the supplier produces Lean's "has already been declared" diagnostic.
-- BimoduleTensorFunctoriality uses a FreeAddGroup quotient and ULift.
-- Local descent and generator extensionality work on the specified Finsupp
-- quotient and its exact generators.

private abbrev gen {X Y : Type*} (x : X) (y : Y) : (X × Y) →₀ ℤ :=
  Finsupp.single (x, y) 1

section Tensor

variable (R : Type*) [Ring R]
variable (X Y : Type*) [AddCommGroup X] [AddCommGroup Y]
variable [Module (MulOpposite R) X] [Module R Y]

private abbrev rel : AddSubgroup ((X × Y) →₀ ℤ) :=
  AddSubgroup.closure
    { z | (∃ (x x' : X) (y : Y), z = gen (x + x') y - gen x y - gen x' y) ∨
          (∃ (x : X) (y y' : Y), z = gen x (y + y') - gen x y - gen x y') ∨
          (∃ (a : R) (x : X) (y : Y),
            z = gen (MulOpposite.op a • x) y - gen x (a • y)) }

abbrev Tensor := HasQuotient.Quotient ((X × Y) →₀ ℤ) (rel R X Y)

variable {X Y}

abbrev pure (x : X) (y : Y) : Tensor R X Y :=
  QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rel R X Y) (gen x y)

private theorem add_left (x x' : X) (y : Y) :
    pure R (x + x') y = pure R x y + pure R x' y := by
  have h : gen (x + x') y - gen x y - gen x' y ∈ rel R X Y :=
    AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨x, x', y, rfl⟩)
  have hz := (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2 h
  change QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rel R X Y) _ = 0 at hz
  rwa [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hz

private theorem add_right (x : X) (y y' : Y) :
    pure R x (y + y') = pure R x y + pure R x y' := by
  have h : gen x (y + y') - gen x y - gen x y' ∈ rel R X Y :=
    AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨x, y, y', rfl⟩))
  have hz := (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2 h
  change QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rel R X Y) _ = 0 at hz
  rwa [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hz

private theorem balance (a : R) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    pure R (MulOpposite.op a • x) y = pure R x (a • y) := by
  have h : gen (MulOpposite.op a • x) y - gen x (a • y) ∈ rel R X Y :=
    AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, x, y, rfl⟩))
  have hz := (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2 h
  change QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rel R X Y) _ = 0 at hz
  rwa [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hz

variable {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]

private def mkAdd {D : Type*} [AddZeroClass D] (f : D → A)
    (ha : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) : D →+ A where
  toFun := f
  map_add' := ha
  map_zero' := by
    have h := ha 0 0
    rw [zero_add] at h
    exact (add_left_cancel (show f 0 + 0 = f 0 + f 0 by simpa only [add_zero] using h)).symm

private def pureLeft (y : Y) : X →+ Tensor R X Y := mkAdd (fun x => pure R x y)
  (fun x x' => add_left R x x' y)

private def pureRight (x : X) : Y →+ Tensor R X Y := mkAdd (pure R x) (add_right R x)

variable (f : X →+ Y →+ A)

private def extend : ((X × Y) →₀ ℤ) →+ A :=
  Finsupp.liftAddHom (fun p => zmultiplesHom A (f p.1 p.2))

private theorem extend_gen (x : X) (y : Y) : extend f (gen x y) = f x y := by
  change Finsupp.liftAddHom _ (Finsupp.single (x, y) (1 : ℤ)) = _
  rw [Finsupp.liftAddHom_apply_single]
  exact one_zsmul _

private theorem rel_le_ker
    (hb : ∀ (a : R) x y, f (MulOpposite.op a • x) y = f x (a • y)) : rel R X Y ≤ (extend f).ker := by
  apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2
  intro z hz
  apply AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
  rcases hz with ⟨x, x', y, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, y, y', rfl⟩ | ⟨a, x, y, rfl⟩
  · rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, extend_gen, extend_gen, extend_gen, map_add,
      AddMonoidHom.add_apply, sub_self]
  · rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, extend_gen, extend_gen, extend_gen, map_add, sub_self]
  · rw [map_sub, extend_gen, extend_gen, hb, sub_self]

private def lift (hb : ∀ (a : R) x y, f (MulOpposite.op a • x) y = f x (a • y)) :
    Tensor R X Y →+ A :=
  QuotientAddGroup.lift (rel R X Y) (extend f) (rel_le_ker R f hb)

@[simp] private theorem lift_pure
    (hb : ∀ (a : R) x y, f (MulOpposite.op a • x) y = f x (a • y)) (x : X) (y : Y) : lift R f hb (pure R x y) = f x y :=
  (QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk _ _ _).trans (extend_gen f x y)

private theorem hom_ext (f g : Tensor R X Y →+ A)
    (h : ∀ x y, f (pure R x y) = g (pure R x y)) : f = g := by
  let q := QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rel R X Y)
  have hq : f.comp q = g.comp q := by
    apply Finsupp.addHom_ext'
    intro p
    apply (zmultiplesHom A).symm.injective
    exact h p.1 p.2
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro z
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective (rel R X Y) z
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hq u

end Tensor

section Maps

variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]
variable {X X' Y Y' : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [AddCommGroup X']
variable [AddCommGroup Y] [AddCommGroup Y']
variable [Module (MulOpposite R) X] [Module (MulOpposite R) X'] [Module R Y] [Module R Y']

private def tensorMap (f : X →ₗ[MulOpposite R] X') (g : Y →ₗ[R] Y') :
    Tensor R X Y →+ Tensor R X' Y' :=
  lift R
    (mkAdd (fun x => (pureRight R (f x)).comp g.toAddMonoidHom) (fun x x' => by
      apply AddMonoidHom.ext
      intro y
      change pure R (f (x + x')) (g y) = pure R (f x) (g y) + pure R (f x') (g y)
      rw [map_add, add_left]))
    (fun a x y => by
      change pure R (f (MulOpposite.op a • x)) (g y) = pure R (f x) (g (a • y))
      rw [map_smul, map_smul, balance])

@[simp] private theorem tensorMap_pure (f : X →ₗ[MulOpposite R] X') (g : Y →ₗ[R] Y')
    (x : X) (y : Y) : tensorMap f g (pure R x y) = pure R (f x) (g y) :=
  lift_pure R _ _ x y

end Maps

section Actions

variable {R K : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring K]
variable {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [AddCommGroup Y]
variable [Module (MulOpposite R) X] [Module R Y]

private def scalarLinear {D E : Type*} [Ring D] [AddCommGroup E] [Module D E] [Module K E]
    [SMulCommClass K D E] (k : K) : E →ₗ[D] E where
  toFun := (k • ·)
  map_add' := smul_add k
  map_smul' d x := smul_comm k d x

@[simp] private theorem scalarLinear_apply {D E : Type*} [Ring D] [AddCommGroup E]
    [Module D E] [Module K E] [SMulCommClass K D E] (k : K) (x : E) :
    (scalarLinear (D := D) k) x = k • x := rfl

@[instance_reducible] private def moduleOfMaps {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] (a : K → E →+ E)
    (h1 : a 1 = AddMonoidHom.id E) (hm : ∀ k l, a (k * l) = (a k).comp (a l))
    (ha : ∀ k l, a (k + l) = a k + a l) (h0 : a 0 = 0) : Module K E where
  smul k x := a k x
  one_smul x := DFunLike.congr_fun h1 x
  mul_smul k l x := DFunLike.congr_fun (hm k l) x
  smul_zero k := map_zero (a k)
  smul_add k := map_add (a k)
  add_smul k l x := DFunLike.congr_fun (ha k l) x
  zero_smul x := DFunLike.congr_fun h0 x

-- The portal assumes the intermediate actions in L1. Here the commuting
-- actions allow descent of the scalar maps and prove the module laws.
@[instance_reducible] def leftModule [Module K X] [SMulCommClass K (MulOpposite R) X] :
    Module K (Tensor R X Y) :=
  moduleOfMaps (fun k => tensorMap (scalarLinear (D := MulOpposite R) k) LinearMap.id)
    (hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      simp only [tensorMap_pure, scalarLinear_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, one_smul,
        AddMonoidHom.id_apply])
    (fun k l => hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      simp only [tensorMap_pure, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, scalarLinear_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
        mul_smul])
    (fun k l => hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      simp only [tensorMap_pure, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, scalarLinear_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
        add_smul, add_left])
    (hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      simp only [tensorMap_pure, scalarLinear_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, zero_smul,
        AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
      exact map_zero (pureLeft R y))

@[simp] theorem left_pure [Module K X] [SMulCommClass K (MulOpposite R) X]
    (k : K) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    (leftModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)).smul k (pure R x y) =
      pure R (k • x) y :=
  tensorMap_pure _ _ x y

@[instance_reducible] def rightModule [Module K Y] [SMulCommClass K R Y] :
    Module K (Tensor R X Y) :=
  moduleOfMaps (fun k => tensorMap LinearMap.id (scalarLinear (D := R) k))
    (hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      simp only [tensorMap_pure, scalarLinear_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, one_smul,
        AddMonoidHom.id_apply])
    (fun k l => hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      simp only [tensorMap_pure, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, scalarLinear_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
        mul_smul])
    (fun k l => hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      simp only [tensorMap_pure, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, scalarLinear_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
        add_smul, add_right])
    (hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      simp only [tensorMap_pure, scalarLinear_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, zero_smul,
        AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
      exact map_zero (pureRight R x))

@[simp] theorem right_pure [Module K Y] [SMulCommClass K R Y]
    (k : K) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    (rightModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)).smul k (pure R x y) =
      pure R x (k • y) :=
  tensorMap_pure _ _ x y

private def smulAdd {D E : Type*} [Ring D] [AddCommGroup E] [Module D E] (d : D) :
    E →+ E where
  toFun := (d • ·)
  map_zero' := smul_zero d
  map_add' := smul_add d

theorem commute {J : Type*} [Ring J] [Module K X] [Module J Y]
    [SMulCommClass K (MulOpposite R) X] [SMulCommClass J R Y] :
    letI := leftModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)
    letI := rightModule (K := J) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)
    SMulCommClass J K (Tensor R X Y) := by
  let l := leftModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)
  let r := rightModule (K := J) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)
  let _ := l
  let _ := r
  refine ⟨fun j k z => ?_⟩
  let f := (smulAdd j : Tensor R X Y →+ Tensor R X Y).comp (smulAdd k)
  let g := (smulAdd k : Tensor R X Y →+ Tensor R X Y).comp (smulAdd j)
  have h : f = g := hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
    change r.smul j (l.smul k (pure R x y)) = l.smul k (r.smul j (pure R x y))
    simp only [l, r, left_pure, right_pure]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

end Actions

section LinearMaps

variable {R K : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring K]
variable {X X' Y Y' : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [AddCommGroup X']
variable [AddCommGroup Y] [AddCommGroup Y']
variable [Module (MulOpposite R) X] [Module (MulOpposite R) X'] [Module R Y] [Module R Y']

private def leftMap [Module K X] [Module K X']
    [SMulCommClass K (MulOpposite R) X] [SMulCommClass K (MulOpposite R) X']
    (f : X →ₗ[MulOpposite R] X') (g : Y →ₗ[R] Y')
    (hf : ∀ k : K, ∀ x, f (k • x) = k • f x) :
    letI := leftModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)
    letI := leftModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X') (Y := Y')
    Tensor R X Y →ₗ[K] Tensor R X' Y' := by
  letI := leftModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)
  letI := leftModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X') (Y := Y')
  let map := tensorMap f g
  refine { map with map_smul' := fun k z => ?_ }
  have h : map.comp (smulAdd k) = (smulAdd k).comp map :=
    hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      change map ((leftModule (K := K)).smul k (pure R x y)) =
        (leftModule (K := K)).smul k (map (pure R x y))
      simp only [map, left_pure, tensorMap_pure, hf]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

private theorem leftMap_pure [Module K X] [Module K X']
    [SMulCommClass K (MulOpposite R) X] [SMulCommClass K (MulOpposite R) X']
    (f : X →ₗ[MulOpposite R] X') (g : Y →ₗ[R] Y')
    (hf : ∀ k : K, ∀ x, f (k • x) = k • f x) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    leftMap f g hf (pure R x y) = pure R (f x) (g y) :=
  tensorMap_pure f g x y

private def rightMap [Module K Y] [Module K Y'] [SMulCommClass K R Y] [SMulCommClass K R Y']
    (f : X →ₗ[MulOpposite R] X') (g : Y →ₗ[R] Y')
    (hg : ∀ k : K, ∀ y, g (k • y) = k • g y) :
    letI := rightModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)
    letI := rightModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X') (Y := Y')
    Tensor R X Y →ₗ[K] Tensor R X' Y' := by
  letI := rightModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y)
  letI := rightModule (K := K) (R := R) (X := X') (Y := Y')
  let map := tensorMap f g
  refine { map with map_smul' := fun k z => ?_ }
  have h : map.comp (smulAdd k) = (smulAdd k).comp map :=
    hom_ext R _ _ fun x y => by
      change map ((rightModule (K := K)).smul k (pure R x y)) =
        (rightModule (K := K)).smul k (map (pure R x y))
      simp only [map, right_pure, tensorMap_pure, hg]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

private theorem rightMap_pure [Module K Y] [Module K Y'] [SMulCommClass K R Y] [SMulCommClass K R Y']
    (f : X →ₗ[MulOpposite R] X') (g : Y →ₗ[R] Y')
    (hg : ∀ k : K, ∀ y, g (k • y) = k • g y) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    rightMap f g hg (pure R x y) = pure R (f x) (g y) :=
  tensorMap_pure f g x y

end LinearMaps

section Assoc

variable {T S R : Type*} [Ring T] [Ring S] [Ring R]
variable {X Y Z : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [AddCommGroup Y] [AddCommGroup Z]
variable [Module (MulOpposite S) X] [Module S Y] [Module (MulOpposite R) Y] [Module R Z]
variable [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S Y] [SMulCommClass S (MulOpposite R) Y]
variable [Module T X] [SMulCommClass T (MulOpposite S) X]

@[reducible] local instance cbRight : Module (MulOpposite R) (Tensor S X Y) := rightModule
@[reducible] local instance bmLeft : Module S (Tensor R Y Z) := leftModule
@[reducible] local instance cbLeft : Module T (Tensor S X Y) := leftModule
local instance cbComm : SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) T (Tensor S X Y) := commute
local instance cbComm' : SMulCommClass T (MulOpposite R) (Tensor S X Y) :=
  SMulCommClass.symm _ _ _

variable (S R X Y Z) in
abbrev L := Tensor R (Tensor S X Y) Z
variable (S R X Y Z) in
abbrev U := Tensor S X (Tensor R Y Z)

variable (S R) in
abbrev lp (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) : L S R X Y Z := pure R (pure S x y) z
variable (S R) in
abbrev up (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) : U S R X Y Z := pure S x (pure R y z)

@[reducible] local instance actL : Module T (L S R X Y Z) := leftModule
@[reducible] local instance actU : Module T (U S R X Y Z) := leftModule

-- Steps 1.1 and 1.2 verify both balancing relations. The forward map
-- descends in C,B with values in additive maps out of M, so additivity in M
-- is built into the first lift. The second balancing relation is checked by
-- hom_ext in the descended variable (steps 2.1 and 2.2).
private def forwardInner : Tensor S X Y →+ Z →+ U S R X Y Z :=
  lift S
    (mkAdd (fun x => mkAdd (fun y => (pureRight S x).comp (pureRight R y)) (fun y y' => by
      apply AddMonoidHom.ext
      intro z
      change up S R x (y + y') z = up S R x y z + up S R x y' z
      simp only [up, add_left, add_right])) (fun x x' => by
      apply AddMonoidHom.ext
      intro y
      apply AddMonoidHom.ext
      intro z
      change up S R (x + x') y z = up S R x y z + up S R x' y z
      exact add_left S x x' _))
    (fun s x y => by
      apply AddMonoidHom.ext
      intro z
      change up S R (MulOpposite.op s • x) y z = up S R x (s • y) z
      rw [up, up, balance, show s • pure R y z = pure R (s • y) z from left_pure s y z])

omit [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S Y] in
private theorem forwardInner_pure (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    (forwardInner (S := S) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) (pure S x y)) z = up S R x y z := by
  rw [forwardInner, lift_pure]
  rfl

private def forward : L S R X Y Z →+ U S R X Y Z :=
  lift R forwardInner (fun r q z => by
    let f := (AddMonoidHom.eval z).comp
      ((forwardInner (S := S) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z)).comp (smulAdd (MulOpposite.op r)))
    let g := (AddMonoidHom.eval (r • z)).comp
      (forwardInner (S := S) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z))
    have h : f = g := hom_ext S _ _ fun x y => by
      change (forwardInner ((rightModule (K := MulOpposite R)).smul
        (MulOpposite.op r) (pure S x y))) z = (forwardInner (pure S x y)) (r • z)
      simp only [right_pure, forwardInner_pure, up, balance]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h q)

private theorem forward_pure (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    forward (lp S R x y z) = up S R x y z := by
  exact (lift_pure R _ _ (pure S x y) z).trans (forwardInner_pure x y z)

private def backwardInner (x : X) : Tensor R Y Z →+ L S R X Y Z :=
  lift R
    (mkAdd (fun y => pureRight R (pure S x y)) (fun y y' => by
      apply AddMonoidHom.ext
      intro z
      change lp S R x (y + y') z = lp S R x y z + lp S R x y' z
      simp only [lp, add_right, add_left]))
    (fun r y z => by
      change lp S R x (MulOpposite.op r • y) z = lp S R x y (r • z)
      exact (congrArg (fun q : Tensor S X Y => pure R q z) (right_pure (MulOpposite.op r) x y)).symm.trans
        (balance R r (pure S x y) z))

omit [SMulCommClass S (MulOpposite R) Y] in
private theorem backwardInner_pure (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    backwardInner x (pure R y z) = lp S R x y z := by
  rw [backwardInner, lift_pure]
  rfl

private def backward : U S R X Y Z →+ L S R X Y Z :=
  lift S (mkAdd (backwardInner (S := S) (R := R) (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z))
    (fun x x' => hom_ext R _ _ fun y z => by
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, backwardInner_pure, lp, add_left]))
    (fun s x q => by
      let f := backwardInner (S := S) (R := R) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) (MulOpposite.op s • x)
      let g := (backwardInner (S := S) (R := R) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) x).comp (smulAdd s)
      have eq : f = g := hom_ext R _ _ fun y z => by
        change backwardInner (S := S) (MulOpposite.op s • x) (pure R y z) =
          backwardInner (S := S) x ((leftModule (K := S)).smul s (pure R y z))
        simp only [left_pure, backwardInner_pure, lp, balance]
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq q)

private theorem backward_pure (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    backward (up S R x y z) = lp S R x y z := by
  exact (lift_pure S _ _ x (pure R y z)).trans (backwardInner_pure x y z)

-- Homomorphisms out of either nesting are determined by their pure triples.
-- This proves the two composite identities in step 3.1.
omit [SMulCommClass S (MulOpposite R) Y] in
private theorem left_ext {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (f g : L S R X Y Z →+ A)
    (h : ∀ x y z, f (lp S R x y z) = g (lp S R x y z)) : f = g :=
  hom_ext R _ _ fun q z =>
    DFunLike.congr_fun (hom_ext S (f.comp (pureLeft R z)) (g.comp (pureLeft R z))
      fun x y => h x y z) q

omit [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S Y] in
private theorem right_ext {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (f g : U S R X Y Z →+ A)
    (h : ∀ x y z, f (up S R x y z) = g (up S R x y z)) : f = g :=
  hom_ext S _ _ fun x q =>
    DFunLike.congr_fun (hom_ext R (f.comp (pureRight S x)) (g.comp (pureRight S x))
      fun y z => h x y z) q

omit [SMulCommClass S (MulOpposite R) Y] in
@[simp] theorem actL_pure (t : T) (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    (actL (T := T)).smul t (lp S R x y z) = lp S R (t • x) y z := by
  change (leftModule (K := T)).smul t (pure R (pure S x y) z) = _
  rw [left_pure]
  change pure R ((leftModule (K := T)).smul t (pure S x y)) z = _
  rw [left_pure]

omit [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S Y] in
@[simp] theorem actU_pure (t : T) (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    (actU (T := T)).smul t (up S R x y z) = up S R (t • x) y z :=
  left_pure t x _

-- Step 3.2 proves equivariance on pure triples and extends it by left_ext.
-- Step 4.1 packages the isomorphism with the specified module structures.
def assoc : L S R X Y Z ≃ₗ[T] U S R X Y Z where
  toAddEquiv :=
    { forward with
      invFun := backward
      left_inv := fun q => DFunLike.congr_fun
        (left_ext (backward.comp forward) (AddMonoidHom.id _)
          fun x y z => by simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, forward_pure, backward_pure,
            AddMonoidHom.id_apply]) q
      right_inv := fun q => DFunLike.congr_fun
        (right_ext (forward.comp backward) (AddMonoidHom.id _)
          fun x y z => by simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, backward_pure, forward_pure,
            AddMonoidHom.id_apply]) q }
  map_smul' t q := by
    let F : L S R X Y Z →+ U S R X Y Z := forward
    have h : F.comp (smulAdd t) = (smulAdd t).comp F :=
      left_ext _ _ fun x y z => by
        change forward ((actL (T := T)).smul t (lp S R x y z)) =
          (actU (T := T)).smul t (forward (lp S R x y z))
        simp only [actL_pure, actU_pure, forward_pure]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h q

@[simp] theorem assoc_pure (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    assoc (T := T) (lp S R x y z) = up S R x y z :=
  forward_pure x y z

variable {X' Y' Z' : Type*} [AddCommGroup X'] [AddCommGroup Y'] [AddCommGroup Z']
variable [Module (MulOpposite S) X'] [Module S Y'] [Module (MulOpposite R) Y'] [Module R Z']
variable [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S Y'] [SMulCommClass S (MulOpposite R) Y']
variable [Module T X'] [SMulCommClass T (MulOpposite S) X']

variable (f : X →ₗ[MulOpposite S] X') (g : Y →ₗ[S] Y') (h : Z →ₗ[R] Z')
variable (hf : ∀ t : T, ∀ x, f (t • x) = t • f x)
variable (hg : ∀ a : MulOpposite R, ∀ y, g (a • y) = a • g y)

private def gRight : Y →ₗ[MulOpposite R] Y' :=
  { g.toAddMonoidHom with map_smul' := hg }

private def mapL : L S R X Y Z →ₗ[T] L S R X' Y' Z' :=
  leftMap (rightMap f g hg) h (fun t q => map_smul (leftMap f g hf) t q)

private def mapU : U S R X Y Z →ₗ[T] U S R X' Y' Z' :=
  leftMap f (leftMap (gRight g hg) h (fun s y => map_smul g s y)) hf

omit [SMulCommClass S (MulOpposite R) Y] [SMulCommClass S (MulOpposite R) Y'] in
private theorem mapL_pure (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    mapL f g h hf hg (lp S R x y z) = lp S R (f x) (g y) (h z) := by
  exact (leftMap_pure (rightMap f g hg) h _ (pure S x y) z).trans
    (congrArg (fun q : Tensor S X' Y' => pure R q (h z)) (rightMap_pure f g hg x y))

omit [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S Y] [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S Y'] in
private theorem mapU_pure (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    mapU f g h hf hg (up S R x y z) = up S R (f x) (g y) (h z) := by
  let g' := gRight g hg
  let hg' (s : S) (y : Y) : g' (s • y) = s • g' y := map_smul g s y
  exact (leftMap_pure f (leftMap g' h hg') hf x (pure R y z)).trans
    (congrArg (pure S (f x)) (leftMap_pure g' h hg' y z))

-- The last part of step 3.2 checks the naturality square on the three
-- generators. left_ext upgrades the equality to the whole source.
include hf hg in
theorem natural :
    ∃ (l : L S R X Y Z →ₗ[T] L S R X' Y' Z') (u : U S R X Y Z →ₗ[T] U S R X' Y' Z'),
      (∀ x y z, l (lp S R x y z) = lp S R (f x) (g y) (h z) ∧
        u (up S R x y z) = up S R (f x) (g y) (h z)) ∧
      ∀ q : L S R X Y Z, assoc (T := T) (l q) = u (assoc (T := T) q) := by
  refine ⟨mapL f g h hf hg, mapU f g h hf hg, fun x y z => ⟨mapL_pure f g h hf hg x y z,
    mapU_pure f g h hf hg x y z⟩, fun q => ?_⟩
  let l := (mapL f g h hf hg).toAddMonoidHom
  let u := (mapU f g h hf hg).toAddMonoidHom
  let e : L S R X Y Z ≃ₗ[T] U S R X Y Z := assoc
  let e' : L S R X' Y' Z' ≃ₗ[T] U S R X' Y' Z' := assoc
  have he : e'.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom.comp l = u.comp e.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom :=
    left_ext _ _ fun x y z => by
      change e' (mapL f g h hf hg (lp S R x y z)) =
        mapU f g h hf hg (e (lp S R x y z))
      simp only [e, e', mapL_pure, mapU_pure, assoc_pure]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he q

end Assoc

section Functors

universe r s v
variable {R : Type r} [Ring R] {S : Type s} [Ring S]

abbrev Bimod (R : Type r) [Ring R] (S : Type s) [Ring S] :=
  AdditiveFunctor (SingleObj (MulOpposite R)) (ModuleCat.{v} S)

local notation "★" => SingleObj.star (MulOpposite R)

abbrev carrier (B : Bimod.{r,s,v} R S) := B.obj.obj ★

private def actionHom (B : Bimod.{r,s,v} R S) : MulOpposite R →+* Module.End S (carrier B) where
  toFun a := (B.obj.map (show ★ ⟶ ★ from a)).hom
  map_one' := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom (B.obj.map_id ★)
  map_mul' a b := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
    (B.obj.map_comp (show ★ ⟶ ★ from b) (show ★ ⟶ ★ from a))
  map_zero' := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom (B.obj.map_zero ★ ★)
  map_add' a b := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
    (B.obj.map_add (f := (show ★ ⟶ ★ from a)) (g := (show ★ ⟶ ★ from b)))

@[reducible] def rightAction (B : Bimod.{r,s,v} R S) : Module (MulOpposite R) (carrier B) :=
  Module.compHom (carrier B) (actionHom B)

theorem rightAction_comm (B : Bimod.{r,s,v} R S) :
    letI := rightAction B
    SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S (carrier B) := by
  let _ := rightAction B
  exact ⟨fun a s x => map_smul (actionHom B a) s x⟩

@[reducible] local instance (B : Bimod.{r,s,v} R S) : Module (MulOpposite R) (carrier B) :=
  rightAction B

def evalRight {B B' : Bimod.{r,s,v} R S} (f : B ⟶ B') :
    carrier B →ₗ[MulOpposite R] carrier B' :=
  { (f.hom.app ★).hom.toAddMonoidHom with
    map_smul' a x := DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
      (f.hom.naturality (show ★ ⟶ ★ from a))) x }

end Functors

end

external.usage: Extends each balanced pairing from pairs of module elements to their free finitely supported integer sums and computes the extension on each generator.
Shows that equality on the integer summands implies equality of the additive maps on the free group. After quotient surjectivity this proves extensionality on the pure tensors.
Descends each additive extension after the three tensor relations put their generated subgroup in its kernel, and evaluates the descended map on quotient classes.

by
  -- Theorem 10.1, p. 32. Portal steps 1.2 and 1.3 supply the comparison
  -- directions after using the article's evaluation direction for the unit.
  intro R _
  refine ⟨NotesTensorDictionary.regular R, ?_⟩
  intro S T _ _ B C _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ TB TC CB pureCB
  refine ⟨NotesTensorDictionary.left_pure B C, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨NotesTensorDictionary.rightModule B C, NotesTensorDictionary.right_pure B C, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨NotesTensorDictionary.rightCommutes B C, NotesTensorDictionary.composition R S T B C,
    NotesTensorDictionary.composition_pure R S T B C⟩

namespace NotesTensorDictionary

open CategoryTheory NotesProofs

-- Ian X, Abelian Categories and Bimodules, Theorem 10.1 (env-10-1).
-- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/abelian-categories-and-bimodules-lecture-notes.pdf#page=32
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/lem-tensoring-defines-a-pseudofunctor-with-interchange
-- The article needs the two natural comparisons from portal steps 1.2–1.3.
-- The later portal coherence and interchange clauses concern the larger
-- pseudofunctor statement.

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

section Tensor

variable {R S : Type u} [Ring R] [Ring S]
variable (B : Type u) [AddCommGroup B] [Module S B] [Module (MulOpposite R) B]
  [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S B]

private abbrev tensor := concreteTensorFunctor (R := R) (S := S) B

private abbrev pure {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} (b : B) (x : X) :
    (tensor (S := S) B).obj X :=
  concretePure (R := R) (M := B) b x

private theorem pure_add_left {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} (b b' : B) (x : X) :
    pure (S := S) B (b + b') x = pure B b x + pure B b' x :=
  (ChoiceFreeWatts.pureBalanced rightAction).1 b b' x

private theorem pure_add_right {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} (b : B) (x x' : X) :
    pure (S := S) B b (x + x') = pure B b x + pure B b x' :=
  (ChoiceFreeWatts.pureBalanced rightAction).2.1 b x x'

private theorem pure_balance {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} (r : R) (b : B) (x : X) :
    pure (S := S) B (MulOpposite.op r • b) x = pure B b (r • x) :=
  (ChoiceFreeWatts.pureBalanced rightAction).2.2 r b x

private theorem smul_pure {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} (s : S) (b : B) (x : X) :
    s • pure (S := S) B b x = pure B (s • b) x :=
  ChoiceFreeWatts.scale_pure rightAction right_commute s b x

private theorem map_pure {X Y : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : X ⟶ Y) (b : B) (x : X) :
    ((tensor (S := S) B).map f) (pure B b x) = pure B b (f x) :=
  concreteTensorMap_pure (S := S) f.hom b x

private theorem tensor_ext {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} {Y : Type u} [AddCommGroup Y]
    (f g : (tensor (S := S) B).obj X →+ Y)
    (h : ∀ b x, f (pure B b x) = g (pure B b x)) : f = g :=
  ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorExt rightAction f g h

private def pureLeft {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} (x : X) : B →+ (tensor (S := S) B).obj X :=
  AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun b => pure B b x) (fun b b' => pure_add_left B b b' x)

private def pureRight {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} (b : B) : X →+ (tensor (S := S) B).obj X :=
  concretePure (R := R) (M := B) b

end Tensor

section Regular

variable (R : Type u) [Ring R]

-- Alphabeta Math, lem-tensoring-defines-a-pseudofunctor-with-interchange,
-- step 1.3. The article's comparison is the unitor itself. The left clause
-- of RegularModuleTensorUnits has definitionally the same quotient and action:
-- op r acts on a by a * r. Its naturality witness is existential, so check
-- naturality for the actual functor map by testing on pure tensors.
-- Theorem 10.1 links Chapter 6 through env-6-5, whose statement is the
-- associator. The unitor is Theorem 6.4 (env-6-4), which is the unit
-- clause formalized by RegularModuleTensorUnits.
theorem regular :
    ∃ unit : tensor (R := R) (S := R) R ≅ Functor.id (ModuleCat.{u} R),
      ∀ (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (r : R) (m : M),
        (unit.hom.app M) (pure R r m) = r • m := by
  obtain ⟨unit, hp, _⟩ := (RegularModuleTensorUnits.{u,u,u,u} R).1
  let F := tensor (R := R) (S := R) R
  let component (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) : F.obj M ≅ M := (unit M).toModuleIso
  have h (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (r : R) (m : M) :
      (component M).hom (pure R r m) = r • m := hp M r m
  refine ⟨NatIso.ofComponents component ?_, h⟩
  intro M N f
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_injective
  apply tensor_ext (S := R) R
  intro r m
  change (component N).hom (F.map f (pure R r m)) =
    f ((component M).hom (pure R r m))
  rw [map_pure, h, h]
  exact (f.hom.map_smul r m).symm

end Regular

section Composition

variable {R S T : Type u} [Ring R] [Ring S] [Ring T]
variable (B C : Type u) [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C]
  [Module S B] [Module (MulOpposite R) B] [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S B]
  [Module T C] [Module (MulOpposite S) C] [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite S) T C]

abbrev composite (S T : Type u) [Ring S] [Ring T]
    (B C : Type u) [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C]
    [Module S B] [Module T C] [Module (MulOpposite S) C]
    [SMulCommClass (MulOpposite S) T C] := (tensor (R := S) (S := T) C).obj (ModuleCat.of S B)

-- Descend right multiplication by applying the additive tensor functor to
-- the S-linear scalar endomorphisms of B. This proves all module laws at once.
private def rightActionHom : MulOpposite R →+* Module.End T (composite S T B C) := by
  let X := ModuleCat.of S B
  let F := tensor (R := S) (S := T) C
  let mapEnd : End X →+* End (F.obj X) :=
    { F.mapEnd X with
      map_zero' := by apply End.ext; exact F.map_zero _ _
      map_add' := by intro f g; apply End.ext; exact F.map_add }
  exact (ModuleCat.endRingEquiv (F.obj X)).toRingHom.comp
    (mapEnd.comp ((ModuleCat.endRingEquiv X).symm.toRingHom.comp (Module.toModuleEnd S B)))

@[instance_reducible] def rightModule : Module (MulOpposite R) (composite S T B C) :=
  Module.compHom _ (rightActionHom (S := S) (T := T) B C)

local instance : Module (MulOpposite R) (composite S T B C) := rightModule B C

theorem rightCommutes : SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) T (composite S T B C) :=
  ⟨fun a t z => (rightActionHom (S := S) (T := T) B C a).map_smul t z⟩

local instance : SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) T (composite S T B C) := rightCommutes B C

theorem right_pure (r : R) (c : C) (b : B) :
    MulOpposite.op r • pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c b =
      pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c (MulOpposite.op r • b) := by
  change ((tensor (R := S) (S := T) C).map
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (Module.toModuleEnd S B (MulOpposite.op r))))
      (pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c b) = _
  rw [map_pure]
  rfl

theorem left_pure (t : T) (c : C) (b : B) :
    t • pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c b =
      pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) (t • c) b :=
  smul_pure C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) t c b

variable (R S T) in
private abbrev src : ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} T :=
  tensor (R := R) (S := S) B ⋙ tensor (R := S) (S := T) C

variable (R S T) in
private abbrev dst : ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} T :=
  tensor (R := R) (S := T) (composite S T B C : Type u)

variable {B C}
variable (X : ModuleCat.{u} R)

variable (S T) in
private abbrev srcPure (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) : (src R S T B C).obj X :=
  pure (S := T) C (X := (tensor (S := S) B).obj X) c (pure (S := S) B b x)

variable (S T) in
private abbrev dstPure (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) : (dst R S T B C).obj X :=
  pure (S := T) (composite S T B C : Type u) (pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c b) x

private theorem src_ext {Y : Type u} [AddCommGroup Y] (f g : (src R S T B C).obj X →+ Y)
    (h : ∀ c b x, f (srcPure S T X c b x) = g (srcPure S T X c b x)) : f = g := by
  apply tensor_ext (S := T) C
  intro c z
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun
    (tensor_ext (S := S) B (f.comp (pureRight (S := T) C c)) (g.comp (pureRight (S := T) C c)) (h c)) z

private theorem dst_ext {Y : Type u} [AddCommGroup Y] (f g : (dst R S T B C).obj X →+ Y)
    (h : ∀ c b x, f (dstPure S T X c b x) = g (dstPure S T X c b x)) : f = g := by
  apply tensor_ext (S := T) (composite S T B C : Type u)
  intro z x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun
    (tensor_ext (S := T) C (f.comp (pureLeft (composite S T B C : Type u) x))
      (g.comp (pureLeft (composite S T B C : Type u) x)) (fun c b => h c b x)) z

-- The registered BalancedTensorAssociativity and NotesBalancedAssoc.assoc
-- use a Finsupp quotient, whereas the reviewed functors use a FreeAddGroup
-- quotient. Use the coordinator's two balanced descents on the actual
-- quotient, including its fixed T-action and the right action above.
-- The portal takes the inverse of its associator in step 1.2. Here the
-- comparison already points from C ⊗ (B ⊗ X) to (C ⊗ B) ⊗ X.
-- ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorLift, tensorLinearLift, their pure formulas, and
-- tensorExt supply descent and uniqueness on this quotient (WattsSupport.lean,
-- SHA-256 853d1dd0016bf0735f7a84559e2f1cbbb701fc3cb0e00395a0e138ffecb1f967).

-- The commuting outer actions used here leave all three rings arbitrary.
variable (S T B C) in
private theorem toCompositeInner_balanced (c : C) :
    ChoiceFreeWatts.Balanced (rightAction (R := R) (M := B))
      (fun b x => dstPure S T X c b x) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b b' x
    change pure (S := T) (composite S T B C : Type u)
      (pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c (b + b')) x = _
    rw [pure_add_right, pure_add_left]
  · intro b x x'
    exact pure_add_right (composite S T B C : Type u) _ x x'
  · intro r b x
    change pure (S := T) (composite S T B C : Type u)
      (pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c (MulOpposite.op r • b)) x = _
    rw [← right_pure (B := B) (C := C) (T := T), pure_balance]

variable (S T B C) in
private def toCompositeInner (c : C) : (tensor (S := S) B).obj X →+ (dst R S T B C).obj X :=
  ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorLift rightAction _ (toCompositeInner_balanced S T B C X c)

variable (S T B C) in
private theorem toCompositeInner_pure (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) :
    toCompositeInner S T B C X c (pure (S := S) B b x) = dstPure S T X c b x :=
  ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorLift_pure rightAction _ (toCompositeInner_balanced S T B C X c) b x

variable (S T B C) in
private theorem toComposite_balanced :
    ChoiceFreeWatts.Balanced (rightAction (R := S) (M := C))
      (toCompositeInner S T B C X · ·) := by
  refine ⟨?_, fun c => map_add (toCompositeInner S T B C X c), ?_⟩
  · intro c c' z
    have h : toCompositeInner S T B C X (c + c') = toCompositeInner S T B C X c + toCompositeInner S T B C X c' := by
      apply tensor_ext (S := S) B
      intro b x
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, toCompositeInner_pure, dstPure, pure_add_left]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z
  · intro s c z
    let scale := DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom ((tensor (S := S) B).obj X) s
    have h : toCompositeInner S T B C X (MulOpposite.op s • c) = (toCompositeInner S T B C X c).comp scale := by
      apply tensor_ext (S := S) B
      intro b x
      change toCompositeInner S T B C X (MulOpposite.op s • c) (pure (S := S) B b x) =
        toCompositeInner S T B C X c (s • pure (S := S) B b x)
      simp only [smul_pure, toCompositeInner_pure, dstPure, pure_balance]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

variable (S T B C) in
private theorem toComposite_outer (t : T) (c : C) (z : (tensor (S := S) B).obj X) :
    toCompositeInner S T B C X (t • c) z = t • toCompositeInner S T B C X c z := by
  let scale := DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom ((dst R S T B C).obj X) t
  have h : toCompositeInner S T B C X (t • c) = scale.comp (toCompositeInner S T B C X c) := by
    apply tensor_ext (S := S) B
    intro b x
    change toCompositeInner S T B C X (t • c) (pure (S := S) B b x) =
      t • toCompositeInner S T B C X c (pure (S := S) B b x)
    simp only [toCompositeInner_pure, dstPure, smul_pure]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

variable (S T B C) in
private def toComposite : (src R S T B C).obj X →ₗ[T] (dst R S T B C).obj X :=
  ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorLinearLift rightAction right_commute
    (toCompositeInner S T B C X · ·) (toComposite_balanced S T B C X) (toComposite_outer S T B C X)

variable (S T B C) in
private theorem toComposite_pure (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) :
    toComposite S T B C X (srcPure S T X c b x) = dstPure S T X c b x :=
  (ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorLinearLift_pure rightAction right_commute
    (toCompositeInner S T B C X · ·) (toComposite_balanced S T B C X) (toComposite_outer S T B C X) c _).trans
    (toCompositeInner_pure S T B C X c b x)

variable (S T B C) in
private theorem fromCompositeInner_balanced (x : X) :
    ChoiceFreeWatts.Balanced (rightAction (R := S) (M := C))
      (fun c (b : B) => srcPure S T X c b x) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c c' b
    exact pure_add_left C c c' (pure (S := S) B b x)
  · intro c b b'
    simp only [srcPure, pure_add_left, pure_add_right]
  · intro s c b
    change srcPure S T X (MulOpposite.op s • c) b x = srcPure S T X c (s • b) x
    simp only [srcPure, pure_balance, smul_pure]

variable (S T B C) in
private def fromCompositeInner (x : X) : composite S T B C →ₗ[T] (src R S T B C).obj X :=
  ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorLinearLift rightAction right_commute _
    (fromCompositeInner_balanced S T B C X x) (fun t c b => (smul_pure C t c (pure (S := S) B b x)).symm)

variable (S T B C) in
private theorem fromCompositeInner_pure (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) :
    fromCompositeInner S T B C X x (pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c b) = srcPure S T X c b x :=
  ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorLinearLift_pure rightAction right_commute _
    (fromCompositeInner_balanced S T B C X x) _ c b

variable (S T B C) in
private theorem fromComposite_balanced :
    ChoiceFreeWatts.Balanced (rightAction (R := R) (M := (composite S T B C : Type u)))
      (fun z x => fromCompositeInner S T B C X x z) := by
  refine ⟨fun z z' x => map_add (fromCompositeInner S T B C X x) z z', ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z x x'
    have h : (fromCompositeInner S T B C X (x + x')).toAddMonoidHom =
        (fromCompositeInner S T B C X x).toAddMonoidHom + (fromCompositeInner S T B C X x').toAddMonoidHom := by
      apply tensor_ext (S := T) C
      intro c b
      simp only [LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
        fromCompositeInner_pure, srcPure, pure_add_right]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z
  · intro r z x
    let scale := (rightActionHom (S := S) (T := T) B C (MulOpposite.op r)).toAddMonoidHom
    have h : (fromCompositeInner S T B C X x).toAddMonoidHom.comp scale =
        (fromCompositeInner S T B C X (r • x)).toAddMonoidHom := by
      apply tensor_ext (S := T) C
      intro c b
      change fromCompositeInner S T B C X x (MulOpposite.op r • pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c b) =
        fromCompositeInner S T B C X (r • x) (pure (S := T) C (X := ModuleCat.of S B) c b)
      simp only [right_pure, fromCompositeInner_pure, srcPure, pure_balance]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

variable (S T B C) in
private def fromComposite : (dst R S T B C).obj X →ₗ[T] (src R S T B C).obj X :=
  ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorLinearLift rightAction right_commute
    (fun z x => fromCompositeInner S T B C X x z) (fromComposite_balanced S T B C X)
    (fun t z x => (fromCompositeInner S T B C X x).map_smul t z)

variable (S T B C) in
private theorem fromComposite_pure (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) :
    fromComposite S T B C X (dstPure S T X c b x) = srcPure S T X c b x :=
  (ChoiceFreeWatts.tensorLinearLift_pure rightAction right_commute
    (fun z x => fromCompositeInner S T B C X x z) (fromComposite_balanced S T B C X) _ _ x).trans
    (fromCompositeInner_pure S T B C X c b x)

private def component : (src R S T B C).obj X ≅ (dst R S T B C).obj X := by
  let forward := toComposite S T B C X
  let backward := fromComposite S T B C X
  refine (LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap forward backward ?_ ?_).toModuleIso
  · apply LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_injective
    apply dst_ext (S := S) (T := T) X
    intro c b x
    change forward (backward (dstPure S T X c b x)) =
      dstPure S T X c b x
    simp only [forward, backward, fromComposite_pure, toComposite_pure]
  · apply LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_injective
    apply src_ext (S := S) (T := T) X
    intro c b x
    change backward (forward (srcPure S T X c b x)) =
      srcPure S T X c b x
    simp only [forward, backward, toComposite_pure, fromComposite_pure]

private theorem component_pure (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) :
    (component (S := S) (T := T) X).hom (srcPure S T X c b x) =
      dstPure S T X c b x :=
  toComposite_pure S T B C X c b x

private theorem src_map_pure {X Y : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) :
    ((src R S T B C).map f) (srcPure S T X c b x) =
      srcPure S T Y c b (f x) := by
  change ((tensor (R := S) (S := T) C).map ((tensor (R := R) (S := S) B).map f))
    (pure (S := T) C c (pure (S := S) B b x)) = _
  rw [map_pure, map_pure]

private theorem dst_map_pure {X Y : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) :
    ((dst R S T B C).map f) (dstPure S T X c b x) =
      dstPure S T Y c b (f x) :=
  map_pure (composite S T B C : Type u) f _ x

-- The generator test in portal step 2.1 is used here for naturality in X,
-- which is the variable of the two functors in Theorem 10.1.
variable (R S T B C) in
def composition : src R S T B C ≅ dst R S T B C := by
  refine NatIso.ofComponents (component (S := S) (T := T) (B := B) (C := C)) ?_
  intro X Y f
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_injective
  apply src_ext (S := S) (T := T) X
  intro c b x
  change (component (S := S) (T := T) Y).hom
      ((src R S T B C).map f (srcPure S T X c b x)) =
    (dst R S T B C).map f ((component (S := S) (T := T) X).hom
      (srcPure S T X c b x))
  rw [src_map_pure, component_pure, component_pure, dst_map_pure]

variable (R S T B C) in
theorem composition_pure (c : C) (b : B) (x : X) :
    ((composition R S T B C).hom.app X) (srcPure S T X c b x) =
      dstPure S T X c b x :=
  component_pure (S := S) (T := T) X c b x

end Composition

by
  -- Ian X, Proposition 10.2 (env-10-2, p. 32).
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/abelian-categories-and-bimodules-lecture-notes.pdf#page=32
  -- Alphabeta Math, steps 1.1, 1.2 and 2.1.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/lem-tensoring-defines-a-pseudofunctor-with-interchange
  -- TensorDictionaryCompositionAndIdentities supplies the right actions,
  -- commuting instances, and pure formulas for both comparisons in step 1.2.
  -- Its comparison maps already point from nested to reassociated tensors.
  intro R S T _ _ _ B B' C C' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    TB TB' TC TC' CB CB' pureCB pureCB'
  open CategoryTheory NotesProofs NotesHorizontalComposition in
  obtain ⟨_, rightCB, hr, commute, assoc, ha⟩ :=
    (TensorDictionaryCompositionAndIdentities R).2 S T B C
  obtain ⟨_, rightCB', hr', commute', assoc', ha'⟩ :=
    (TensorDictionaryCompositionAndIdentities R).2 S T B' C'
  let _ : Module (MulOpposite R) CB := rightCB
  let _ : Module (MulOpposite R) CB' := rightCB'
  let _ : SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) T CB := commute
  let _ : SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) T CB' := commute'
  refine ⟨rightCB, rightCB', hr, hr', commute, commute', assoc, assoc', ha, ha', ?_⟩
  intro β γ
  -- Use the already descended tensor transformation from step 1.1 and the
  -- concrete functor map. Their composite implements the balanced lift of
  -- (c, b) ↦ γ(c) ⊗ β(b) with its T-linearity built in. The registered
  -- BimoduleTensorFunctoriality gives an existential functor in an additive
  -- functor encoding, so its witnesses do not fix these concrete carriers.
  -- NaturalTransformationsByRegularEvaluation classifies arbitrary tensor
  -- transformations. Here β and γ already specify both transformations.
  let f : CB ⟶ CB' :=
    (tensorBimoduleMapNatTrans γ).app (ModuleCat.of S B) ≫
      TC'.map (ModuleCat.ofHom β.val)
  have hf (c : C) (b : B) : f (pureCB c b) = pureCB' (γ.val c) (β.val b) := by
    change (tensor (R := S) (S := T) C').map (ModuleCat.ofHom β.val)
      ((tensorBimoduleMapNatTrans γ).app (ModuleCat.of S B)
        (NotesHorizontalComposition.pure (S := T) c b)) = _
    rw [app_pure, NotesHorizontalComposition.map_pure]
    rfl
  have hright (r : R) (z : CB) :
      f (MulOpposite.op r • z) = MulOpposite.op r • f z := by
    let sourceAction : CB →+ CB := AddMonoidHom.mk' (MulOpposite.op r • ·) (smul_add _)
    let targetAction : CB' →+ CB' := AddMonoidHom.mk' (MulOpposite.op r • ·) (smul_add _)
    have h : f.hom.toAddMonoidHom.comp sourceAction =
        targetAction.comp f.hom.toAddMonoidHom := by
      apply tensor_ext (S := T) (P := C) (X := ModuleCat.of S B)
      intro c b
      change f (rightCB.smul (MulOpposite.op r) (pureCB c b)) =
        rightCB'.smul (MulOpposite.op r) (f (pureCB c b))
      rw [hr, hf, hf, hr', β.property]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z
  let δ : BimoduleMap (R := R) (S := T) (M := CB.carrier) (N := CB'.carrier) :=
    ⟨f.hom, hright⟩
  refine ⟨δ, hf, ?_⟩
  -- Step 2.1 uses the generator computation in each variable of the
  -- iterated tensor. Mathlib's horizontal component applies γ first and
  -- then the image of β under TC'. The article uses the other order,
  -- which yields the same pure tensor by the two component formulas.
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext M
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_injective
  apply tensor_ext (S := T) (P := C) (X := TB.obj M)
  intro c z
  let left := ((tensorBimoduleMapNatTrans β ◫ tensorBimoduleMapNatTrans γ) ≫ assoc'.hom).app M
  let right := (assoc.hom ≫ tensorBimoduleMapNatTrans δ).app M
  let pc : TB.obj M →+ (TB ⋙ TC).obj M := concretePure (R := S) (M := C) c
  have h : left.hom.toAddMonoidHom.comp pc = right.hom.toAddMonoidHom.comp pc := by
    apply tensor_ext (S := S) (P := B) (X := M)
    intro b m
    change left (pc (NotesHorizontalComposition.pure (S := S) b m)) =
      right (pc (NotesHorizontalComposition.pure (S := S) b m))
    dsimp only [left, right, NatTrans.comp_app]
    rw [NatTrans.hcomp_app]
    change (assoc'.hom.app M)
        (TC'.map ((tensorBimoduleMapNatTrans β).app M)
          ((tensorBimoduleMapNatTrans γ).app (TB.obj M)
            (NotesHorizontalComposition.pure (S := T) c
              (NotesHorizontalComposition.pure (S := S) b m)))) =
      (tensorBimoduleMapNatTrans δ).app M
        ((assoc.hom.app M)
          (NotesHorizontalComposition.pure (S := T) c (NotesHorizontalComposition.pure (S := S) b m)))
    rw [app_pure, NotesHorizontalComposition.map_pure, app_pure, ha', ha]
    exact (congrArg (fun p : CB'.carrier => concretePure (R := R) (M := CB'.carrier) p m)
      (hf c b).symm).trans (app_pure δ M (pureCB c b) m).symm
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

by

  -- maps for the balanced universal property, outer actions and
  -- comparison maps. The RingCat model uses the given unital actions,
  -- including the right action of the opposite ring.
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨(fun {_ _ _} G F => MoritaCoherence.tensor G F),
    (fun {_ _ _} G F g f => MoritaCoherence.pure G F g f), ?_, ?_,
    (fun {_ _ _ _ _ _ _} g f => MoritaCoherence.tensorMap g f),
    (fun {_ _ _ _} H G F => MoritaCoherence.assoc H G F),
    (fun {_ _} F => MoritaCoherence.leftUnitor F),
    (fun {_ _} F => MoritaCoherence.rightUnitor F),
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro C B A G F
    exact ⟨MoritaCoherence.pure_balanced G F, MoritaCoherence.lift_unique G F⟩
  · intro C B A G F g f
    exact ⟨fun c => MoritaCoherence.left_pure G F c g f,
      fun a => MoritaCoherence.right_pure G F a g f⟩
  · intro C B A G G' F F' g f y x
    exact MoritaCoherence.tensorMap_pure g f y x
  · intro D C B A H G F h g f
    exact MoritaCoherence.assoc_pure H G F h g f
  · intro B A F b f
    exact MoritaCoherence.leftUnitor_pure F b f
  · intro B A F a f
    exact MoritaCoherence.rightUnitor_pure F f a
  · -- Step 2.1 compares both routes on fourfold pure tensors.
    intro E D C B A K H G F
    exact MoritaCoherence.pentagon K H G F
  · -- Step 2.2 uses the middle-ring balancing relation.
    intro C B A G F
    exact MoritaCoherence.triangle G F
